crons.name: heartbeat
crons.prompt: Read HEARTBEAT.md and follow its instructions. Update your heartbeat, check inbox, work on assigned tasks.

crons.name: market-stats
crons.prompt: Run TZ=America/Vancouver date +%H. If hour not 06, 07, or 08, exit silently. Sentinel: STAMP=data/.cron-runs/market-stats-$(TZ=America/Vancouver date +%F); if [ -f $STAMP ], exit silently. Otherwise: run market-stats-watcher skill. Refresh Kamloops + Okanagan stats. Drop summary to data/brew/$(date +%F)-market.md so Avery can pull it for the morning brew. On success: mkdir -p data/.cron-runs && touch $STAMP.

crons.name: listing-copy-review
crons.prompt: Run TZ=America/Vancouver date +%H. If hour not in {10,11,12}, exit silently. Sentinel: STAMP=data/.cron-runs/listing-copy-review-$(TZ=America/Vancouver date +%F); if [ -f $STAMP ], exit silently. Otherwise: review active listings. Any with weak copy or missing photos? Surface as task to Avery. On success: mkdir -p data/.cron-runs && touch $STAMP.

crons.name: campaign-check
crons.prompt: Run TZ=America/Vancouver date +%A. If output is not Monday, exit silently. Sentinel: STAMP=data/.cron-runs/campaign-check-$(TZ=America/Vancouver date +%F); if [ -f $STAMP ], exit silently. Otherwise: review marketing/runs/. Anything pending? Anything underperforming? Compose weekly marketing summary. On success: mkdir -p data/.cron-runs && touch $STAMP.
